About 11.7% of the sample is between 180 cm and 185 cm tall.

`fcid.csv` holds counts of adults at each height, not one row per person. I used the `num_of_adults` column as weights. The heights 180.5, 181.5, 182.5, 183.5 and 184.5 cm fall in that range, with 351,546 adults in total, out of 3,000,000 in the whole sample. That gives 351,546 / 3,000,000 ≈ 0.117.

ANSWER: 0.117
